title: call.overrun@1
description: A tool call still running past its expected time (#120): what it waits on, how long it has run, and whether a deadline was attached to it. The agent hears it at its next hook; it never becomes a wait on you.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

call.description: The agent's ID for the call, as its tool.before has it.

kind.description: The call's kind: shell, read, edit, write, search, fetch, mcp or unknown.

command.description: A shell call's command; null for another kind.

expected_ms.description: The time expected for it, from its kind and from how long the same command took before.

ran_ms.description: How long it had run when the overrun was recorded.

deadline.description: attached: the command never ends on its own and the adapter rewrote its input with the expected time as its deadline; recorded: it never ends on its own, but the session asks about commands or the adapter can't change one, so only the overrun is recorded; none: a command that ends on its own.

x-closure.closed: each value is a state the record defines and every reader acts on, so a value outside the list has no meaning
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema
